name: eslint-plugin-makefmt
description: ESLint plugin that formats Makefiles and justfiles with makefmt. Aligns assignments and line continuations, indents conditionals, and formats recipes as shell.
author: Nazmus Sayad

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @makefmt/wasm build && mkdir -p dist && cp node_modules/@makefmt/wasm/dist/makefmt.wasm dist/makefmt.wasm && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.js --format=esm --platform=node --target=node20 --external:@eslint/plugin-kit && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp ../../LICENSE LICENSE
